selection_algorithm: Greedily cover declared weak metadata categories; score remaining normalized deficit divided by corpus subject availability, break ties with SHA-256(seed,subject), then fill to 17 subjects by the same hash order. Pose values and model outcomes are never inspected.
window_selection: Eligible metadata-matched clips are SHA-256 ordered per task/gap. Each clip contributes one deterministic interior window; no subject contributes more than four windows per task/gap.

pending_reviewed_tasks.static: Requires a frozen low-motion detector followed by representative review.
pending_reviewed_tasks.landing: Requires event-level descending-to-support proposals and representative review; source metadata has no explicit landing labels.
pending_reviewed_tasks.contact_quality: Requires reviewed support transitions, hand contacts, moving supports, uneven ground, and penetration-risk scenes.
pending_reviewed_tasks.naturalness_and_intent: Requires independent animator ratings/correction time; weak metadata cannot establish either.

exposure_boundary.interpretation: A new future-model development split, not untouched confirmation.
